newsitem.title: USA: Warner Discovery Records CEO retires.
newsitem.headline: Warner Discovery Records CEO retires.

text.p: Syd Birenbaum will step down as president and chief executive officer of Time Warner Inc.'s Discovery Records label, which is being merged with Warner's Sire Records Group, a spokesman for Discovery said.
The spokesman said Joel Wertman will act as general manager for Discovery as it prepares for the merger.
Industry sources have said Seymour Stein, currently president of Warner's Elektra Entertainment Group, will leave his current post to head the new merged entity.
Birenbaum is credited with taking Discovery to profitability and growing the label into a serious player in jazz and new age and contemporary genres.
Discovery has a staff of about 35 people. Sire is also a small label, but further details were not available.
Warner's music labels have been experiencing a lot of restructuing and turbulance in the past year, including layoffs at it Atlantic Records label.
